canonical_title: My portfolio: Web Application for Portfolio Builder
aliases: My portfolio: Web Application for Résumé Builder
abstract:
A résumé is a one-page summary of your professional experience, whether it is new or has been ongoing for some time (two pages only under special circumstances). It highlights the jobs you've done and presently hold, the responsibilities you've taken on, the talents you've developed, and the traits you bring to the table, just like a portfolio does.

My portfolio is an online application that allow for the creation of an individual's résumé or portfolio. The method is simple to use, and it eliminates the need to think about and build a CV based on qualifications. The method was designed to make creating a creative-looking résumé to a professional-looking résumé straightforward for people of all ages, from children to adults. Individuals must simply fill out a form that includes questions from the default required fields, such as personal questions, educational questions, qualities, interests, and abilities. Users' responses are saved, and the system automatically generates a well-structured résumé based on the template selected by the user. Users can create résumés in the PDF format.

domain.evidence: The project is an online résumé/portfolio builder: the major purpose is to assist adults and children in showcasing their best work and keeping track of their successes, abilities, and potential, and to have a CV to gain a job interview.

abstract: As the economy grows, people are increasingly looking for quality of life. Many families and individuals need to buy cars. The demand for cars is increasing year after year. Since the mid-1990s, the development of e-commerce has attracted the world's attention. Many companies have used the internet, a powerful e-commerce platform, to create web pages and applications for online car transactions. Currently, most automotive markets have a complex sales process. The process usually involves the user entering the sales module and manually entering the make, model, and other relevant information about the car before the sales process can be completed and the sale recorded. This sales process is too cumbersome and degrades the user experience. This project proposes a method that uses a vehicle identification number or image to identify the car and automatically fill in the information. This approach effectively reduces the user entry process, optimizes the sales process, and improves the user experience.

abstract:
The fuel and gasoline industry plays an important role in the world's Gross Domestic Product by providing energy resources. Fuel and gas companies require high operational efficiency in order to maintain profits, because the oil global economic framework impacts everything from transportation to heating and electricity to industrial production and manufacturing. Service station business at this time, not only managing or thinking of a business strategy to be profitable, but it also includes the management of fuel storage and there are a lot of problems occurring during this business.

FSRS is a recommender system that focuses on recommending the gasoline and fuel stock as a solution to predict future purchases to appropriate the fuel stock situation for service station operators to be easier to manage business.

canonical_title: Computerized Control of Selective Perception in the Study of 'Boring' Subjects
advisor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Dobri Atanassov Batovski
committee: Asst. Prof. Dr. Anilkumar Kothalil Gopalakrishnan
abstract: As a result of COVID-19, online learning is increasingly promoted and used for teaching and learning. The effectiveness of online learning is one of the main concerns of many people. Selective perception refers to the way people perceive certain information that they want to perceive through mediated information while automatically ignoring other, contrary information. Students' selective perceptions make it difficult to concentrate on learning, especially in 'boring' subjects. Students are often distracted during lectures or other learning activities. Gamification and Rewards can directly alter people's processing of specific stimuli and increase their attentional priority. Research has shown that gamification and rewards play a very important role in students' selective cognition. It can motivate students to learn and effectively improve their perception of learning. Integrating gamification and rewards into online learning can increase students' motivation and attention. This report references improving online teaching and learning, especially in 'boring' subjects.

canonical_title: Chassy: A Car Service Management System
abstract: In this digital age, technology has transformed almost every aspect of our lives, from ordering food to cleaning. And the service industry is no exception. Thanks to innovative applications and websites, businesses can easily keep track of their clients, services, inventories, and more. That's why Chassy was created. Chassy is a mobile and desktop-based web application designed to streamline the operations of car service companies. With Chassy, businesses can efficiently manage customer information, vehicle details, employee data, service records, monthly and daily transactions, revenue, and more. Chassy empowers car service companies to work smarter, not harder.
